alt: Court Rejection Notice image from Green Filing dated July 23, 2026, rejecting the initial Small Claims filing in Nicolas Hernandez v. Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles County (L.A. Care) due to missing first/last name of the Agent for Service of Process.
full_text: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles. Notice of Court Rejection of Electronic Filing. Transaction Number: 26LA01571304. Court received Date: 07/22/2026, Court received Time: 10:28 pm. Notice Generated Date: 07/23/2026, Notice Generated Time: 8:17 am. Documents Electronically Rejected: Plaintiff's Claim and Order to Go to Small Claims Court, Request to Waive Court Fees. This electronic filing was rejected based on the following reason(s): Reject Reason Other: Please list the first and last name of an authorized agent for #2 on the SC100. Thank You.
summary: Court Rejection Notice from Green Filing dated July 23, 2026, rejecting the initial SC-100 filing because the Agent for Service block lacked a specific individual's first and last name.
